description: An abstract Java class for evaluating infix expressions with support for custom functions, operators, constants, and brackets. It provides a templated framework for creating specific evaluators by subclassing and implementing abstract methods for value conversion and operation evaluation.

classes.name: AbstractEvaluator
classes.description: An abstract class that facilitates infix expression evaluation with support for user-defined functions, operators, constants, and brackets.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression with optional context, returning a result of type T, using a shunting-yard algorithm approach.

methods.name: toValue
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a literal string into a value of type T.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Method to evaluate a Constant of type T given an evaluation context.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Method to evaluate an Operator of type T given an iterator of operands and context.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Method to evaluate a Function of type T given an iterator of arguments and context.

methods.name: doFunction
methods.description: Executes a function with a specified number of arguments within the evaluation context.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of arguments from the value stack for function/operator evaluation.

methods.name: toToken
methods.description: Converts a string token into a Token object, identifying functions, operators, brackets, or literals.

methods.name: getBracketPair
methods.description: Retrieves the bracket pair associated with a token string.
